quests.title: The Hill Above Scarborough
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Scarborough I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at two in the afternoon, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$57, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Helensburgh
quests.blurb: Done at Helensburgh on the long weekend for something that is only an offence if a sign says so, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed. How do you photograph a thing not being somewhere? That is your problem now.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Lapstone
quests.blurb: Nobody planted the strip at Lapstone. I did, on the week of the show, at twenty past four, so nobody would ask. I would like the fifteenth to go badly for council.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Waitara
quests.blurb: Started on the week of the show. In off the Waitara late train, gone before the first delivery, every time, and I am past being reasonable about it. Come in on the late one and watch the loading door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$48 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Bardwell Park
quests.blurb: 21 years above Bardwell Park. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since a wet Monday the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Ingleburn
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Ingleburn, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$58 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Rosehill Gardens
quests.blurb: Somebody set the Rosehill Gardens clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. The old crew drink near Tramway Avenue on a wet Monday. Go and ask, and nobody will put it in writing.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Tramway Avenue, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Asquith
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Asquith at five in the morning, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Granville
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the the back of seven out of Granville runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$49 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Pymble
quests.blurb: The last one through Pymble carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Gordon, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Gordon
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Dulwich Grove Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 40 boards at Dulwich Grove on school holidays and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Gadigal Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Gadigal. Since the first of the month they have not turned up, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Gadigal kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $56 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Beverly Hills
quests.blurb: The board at Beverly Hills says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Olympic Park
quests.blurb: Everything anyone leaves on the Olympic Park line ends up in a room and the room is full. Nine hundred umbrellas and one a laminated sign with a name on it and a number that rings out. Go to the address on the tag.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$62 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Minto
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. The first of the month, Minto to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Glebe Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Glebe. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$63, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Carlingford
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession at Carlingford. Find them before a grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Mascot Regular
quests.blurb: Same stool since before I bought the place off Mascot road. Gone since a Tuesday, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. I would like to know whether to keep the stool.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Surry Hills
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Surry Hills because of one abandoned car, and it has been like that since the merge. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$60 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Douglas Park
quests.blurb: One colour, grey, the same grey in Douglas Park as in every other suburb. I would like something of this one to exist afterwards, and they keep sending a different bloke.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: Contesting It at Pyrmont Bay
quests.blurb: Two hundred and eighty-five dollars at Pyrmont Bay for a thing the sign did not say, because the sign is not there. The form wants evidence. Go and photograph the absence.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Leppington
quests.blurb: A metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at Leppington, dead for 23 years and not dead now. Council mows on the fifteenth and does not know what is in it. Stand near it and stop the man with the whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.blurb: Started on every second Friday. In off the Bexley North late train, gone before the first delivery, every time, and it has been like that since the merge. Come in on the late one and watch the loading door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
